segments.title: Magazine hit during an 18-inch-gun engagement
segments.summary: A short 18-inch-gun clip captures the reaction to a strike that is repeatedly identified as a magazine hit.
segments.body: The reaction begins with the thought that the same thing may have happened before, followed by surprise as the hit becomes clear. The magazine is then named several times as the part of the ship that was struck. The repeated identification makes this a concise watch point for how abruptly a magazine hit can change a heavy-gun engagement. The transcript does not identify the ship, describe the penetration or damage sequence, or finish the closing phrase after "the lesson of," so it cannot support a more detailed technical account.

evidence.note: The reaction builds from recognizing what happened to calling it a magazine hit.
The transcript repeats that the magazine was hit while framing the moment as the lesson from the clip.
